laws: V10 remains CURRENT_BASELINE and V11 remains CANDIDATE.
No new scheduler, queue, family, CURRENT or persistence authority.
Supabase may be read only if useful as legacy evidence; no task may require it to complete.
Public GitHub never stores private transcripts, audio, tokens, signed URLs, PII or private packets.
A missing live source is UNKNOWN/STALE/UNAVAILABLE, never numeric zero or fake success.

browser_contract.data_layer: Keep window.PROMETEO_DATA_V11={load,refresh,readCache}; add truthful GitHub degraded fallback without changing caller ABI.
browser_contract.ingress: window.PROMETEO_INGRESS_V1.submit({page,text,kind}) -> Promise<{status,ref,queued,error}>; MUST fail closed and MUST NOT expose a repository credential.
browser_contract.preview: Workspace cards may render only static images/metadata. Never iframe/live-render project pages in the listing.
browser_contract.stats: If compiled stats are absent/stale, render unavailable/stale; do not synthesize 0.

durable_contract.project_context: Compile from existing project STATE/authority refs; context is projection, never a new owner.
durable_contract.closure: Archive terminal closures/verified outcomes, not heartbeat/event exhaust.
durable_contract.recovery: Fresh runtime identity/epoch; never resurrect historical liveness.
